title: Ministry of Digital Development and Information
what_it_is: Ministry of Digital Development and Information

sections.label: Smart Nation 2.0 AI adoption
sections.summary: MDDI will refine Smart Nation 2.0 strategies, build capabilities, boost innovation and accelerate AI adoption in enterprises and workforce.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI) will refine our Smart Nation 2.0 strategies to navigate rising geopolitical and economic uncertainties and build a thriving digital future for all Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: To seize growth opportunities, MDDI will build capabilities, boost innovation and accelerate AI adoption in our enterprises and workforce.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We will support enterprises ready to go further in embedding AI into their core business processes to generate greater value.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We will also anchor more AI Centres of Excellence to deepen their capabilities here.

sections.label: Scams and online safety
sections.summary: The Government will tackle scams with technical detection and prevention, and set up an Online Safety Commission for victims of online harms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The Government will continue to tackle scams on multiple fronts, including by deploying technical solutions for detection and prevention.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We will set up the Online Safety Commission to support victims of online harms in seeking timely relief from perpetrators and platforms.

sections.label: National cybersecurity standards
sections.summary: MDDI will raise baseline cybersecurity standards, promote cyber hygiene, and strengthened incident reporting requirements for Critical Information Infrastructure owners.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: MDDI will raise our baseline cybersecurity standards nationally, including by promoting stronger cyber hygiene practices, particularly in entities that handle sensitive data or critical systems.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We have strengthened incident reporting requirements for Critical Information Infrastructure owners to detect malicious cyber activities early, enabling timely responses.

sections.label: Core digital infrastructure investment
sections.summary: MDDI will invest in core digital infrastructure for connectivity and study 6G, non-terrestrial networks and quantum to futureproof networks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: MDDI will continue to invest in core digital infrastructure to ensure robust connectivity, and study areas such as 6G, non-terrestrial networks and frontier technologies like quantum to futureproof our networks.

sections.label: Inclusive trusted Smart Nation
sections.summary: MDDI is committed to building an inclusive, trusted and forward-looking Smart Nation with people, enterprises and partners.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: MDDI is committed to building an inclusive, trusted and forward-looking Smart Nation, in close partnership with our people, enterprises and partners.
